name: Luigi Musso
features: olive skin, dark hair combed back from a high forehead, dark eyes, oval face, neat features, slim build, intense proud expression
bio: A Roman who came to Ferrari from sportscars and won the 1956 Argentine Grand Prix, finishing third in the 1957 world championship. The last Italian to win a Grand Prix for Ferrari for a long while, and the last of Enzo's drivers to die in the terrible run of 1957-58: chasing Hawthorn at Reims in 1958, his Ferrari went off at the fast right-hander beyond the pits.
